name: VisionNeRF
definition: A novel view synthesis method that infers a 3D representation from a single unposed input image by combining global features learned from a Vision Transformer (ViT) and local appearance features extracted from a 2D CNN, rendered via a NeRF-based MLP.
summary: VisionNeRF synthesizes novel views from a single unposed image by combining Vision Transformer global features with CNN local features to resolve self-occlusion.
